1.note: DELEGATE approval under the brief's DECISION POLICY (no clarifying questions). Architecture, stackup, IC and constraint set accepted as written. User may still interject - nothing is fabricated yet.

2.note: DELEGATE approval per the brief's DECISION POLICY. erc 0/0, review 0 errors/7 warnings, 2 fixed + 5 waived. Load step accepted AT the 200mV limit on the corrected reading - disclosed, not smoothed.

4.note: DELEGATE approval per the brief's DECISION POLICY. All gates pass. Load step AT the 200mV limit and loop PM unbounded at the true Cout floor - both disclosed, bring-up bench item #1.

decisions.what: Unattended run: orchestrator answered all 33 requirements open questions as delegate (requirements-answers.md)
decisions.why: Brief DECISION POLICY forbids clarifying questions; no mains/battery/motor/>30V/RF flags apply, so no safety unknown is being guessed

decisions.what: 4-layer stackup, 1oz outer / 0.5oz inner
decisions.why: Brief demands an uncut GND plane directly under the switching components plus 2.05 W natural-convection cooling on <=50x40mm; 2L cannot give both the image plane and the bottom thermal copper

decisions.what: Add a 4A slow-blow input fuse (DCR <=30 mOhm) beyond the brief's protection list
decisions.why: IC OCP+hiccup cannot protect against a shorted high-side switch; upstream supply current limit is unstated, so the fuse is what bounds fault energy on-board

decisions.what: Target switching frequency 400-700 kHz
decisions.why: Below the AM broadcast band, keeps 18V-input min-on-time and switching loss comfortable, and allows 20-40% ripple with a stocked inductor

decisions.what: Spawn tier deviation: Fable 5 unavailable (out of credits); judgment roles run on Opus instead
decisions.why: Playbook forbids silent downgrade - Opus is the nearest available tier for architect/placement/reviewer roles; recorded rather than hidden

decisions.what: Input fuse: take the 5A slow-blow (Bel 0685T5000-01, 5032 pcs) over the spec-ideal 4A sibling (174 pcs)
decisions.why: Requirements Q24 binds stock >=2000 pcs and the brief says an out-of-stock part is a failed design; 5A still opens on a bolted fault and costs only 119 mW at the 2.44 A worst case

decisions.what: P3 must pull screw-terminal body height, pin diameter and recommended hole size from the vendor datasheet - LCSC attributes do not carry them
decisions.why: Footprint cannot be built or DFM-checked on missing mechanical data; flagged by the protection scout as its open item

decisions.what: All MLCCs must be X7R (no X5R anywhere); Cout bank moves to 22uF/25V 1210 X7R
decisions.why: Architect computed 83-87 C board surface; X5R is rated 85 C so it is a latent failure, and the X7R part also derates less on DC bias (~12% vs ~25%)

decisions.what: Add a 15V Zener + gate resistor clamp on the reverse-polarity P-FET gate
decisions.why: AO4407A survives 18V static on its +/-25V Vgs, but the architect's 25.4V hot-plug ring on the screw terminals exceeds it; the clamp is the cheap fix

decisions.what: In1 and In2 both solid GND; no power net may use an inner layer
decisions.why: 0.5oz inner copper needs 3.0-4.6mm widths for these currents per IPC-2152, which is unroutable - so power stays on 1oz outer and the inners are pure return/thermal

decisions.what: Feedback divider uses 0.1% resistors regardless of IC choice
decisions.why: Reference tolerance alone spans -1.2%/+1.8% across the candidates and already eats 60-95% of the +/-2% budget; FB bias current error is negligible (<=0.1%) so the divider tolerance is the only lever left

decisions.what: RC snubber values come from general practice, not a vendor citation - footprint sized generously and left DNP
decisions.why: None of the three candidate vendors publishes a snubber value; the brief wants the footprint anyway, so honest sourcing is to mark it uncited rather than invent a citation

decisions.what: P2 may revisit the 4.0A current-limit-minimum floor - it was a delegate tightening (Q5), not a user requirement
decisions.why: It is the single rule disqualifying LMR33630 (3.85A min, ~3.375A guaranteed Iout = 12.5% over the 3.0A load), and the AP64350 that satisfies it carries a 7-10mA UVLO penalty and external compensation

decisions.what: OVERRIDE of delegate answer Q14: UVLO retargeted from 6.5V/6.0V to 6.2V/5.3V
decisions.why: 0.5V hysteresis is less than this board's own 0.49V cable drop at 2.44A (motorboating), and VON=6.5V at the max threshold corner lands ~7.0V so the converter could refuse to start at its minimum rated input; also drops the UVLO divider draw from 81-181mW to 1-2mW

decisions.what: Buck IC: AP64350SP-13 at 500 kHz (RT=200k)
decisions.why: Decided on MAX Rds(on) 75/45 mOhm vs LMR33630's TYPICAL 95/66; TI's own max column gives 1.65W conduction -> Tj ~112C, over the 105C limit. SY8205 rejected on preliminary datasheet with typ-only Rds

decisions.what: 1 oz outer copper; both vendor reference layouts (2 oz) lose
decisions.why: JLC's only 4L/1.6mm 2oz-outer lamination has a 0.4284mm L1-L2 prepreg vs 1080B's 0.2444mm - nearly doubles thermal-via resistance and pushes the image plane 75% further from the hot loop; net +0.8C, so 2oz is worse here

decisions.what: Stackup JLC04161H-1080B; F.Cu + In1 + In2 + B.Cu ALL GND
decisions.why: JLC inner copper is 0.0152mm - thinner than the nominal 0.5oz the rule assumed - so inner power widths would need 3.5-5.3mm; declared explicitly because the pipeline default would otherwise pour In2 as +5V

decisions.what: Single flat root sheet (refdes 1-99, #PWR 100), 33 placed parts
decisions.why: Small board; hierarchy rejected to eliminate the /<sheet>/<LABEL> net-name mismatch class the recipe warns about

decisions.what: R6 feedback top resistor 116k -> 115k (0.1%)
decisions.why: 116k is not an E96 value and has zero 0603 stock at any tolerance; 115k/22.1k is what the AP64350 datasheet's own 5V reference design specifies, and 118k was rejected for failing the high corner at 5.130V

decisions.what: U1 ships with NO true pin-compatible alternate (explicit empty list)
decisions.why: Pin-by-pin comparison shows AP64350 and LMR33630 differ on 4 of 8 pins and use different compensation architectures; recording the single-source risk honestly beats listing a fake second source

decisions.what: AO4407A Rds(on) budget checked at the real operating gate drive (Vgs = -Vin, clamped -15V), not at the datasheet's -4.5/-5V row
decisions.why: Gate sits at GND and source at VIN in this topology so Vgs spans -7V to -15V; at the 12V spec point Vgs=-12V gives 13 mOhm max = 26 mW, inside the 22 mOhm budget line. The -5V row (38 mOhm max) is not an operating condition on this board

decisions.what: AO4407A datasheet has no land pattern - librarian uses standard JEDEC MS-012 SOIC-8, 1.27mm pitch
decisions.why: The 4-page Rev3 (2008) PDF carries no mechanical/recommended-land drawing; sourcing the footprint from the JEDEC standard is honest, inventing pad dimensions from the PDF would not be

decisions.what: FB bias-current error treated as an ASSUMPTION, not a datasheet fact - P1 reference-design claimed <=0.1% but the datasheet states no value
decisions.why: Divider current is 0.8V/22.1k = 36 uA, so a typical 10-100 nA FB bias is 0.03-0.3% of it - safe, but it must be labelled an engineering assumption since the vendor never publishes the number

decisions.what: Thermal via array 16 x 0.3mm at 1.0mm pitch is OUR derivation - the vendor spec is only qualitative
decisions.why: AP64350 datasheet says merely 'add as many vias as possible' with an uncounted illustrative array; the numeric array comes from the P1 architect's 1.9 K/W calculation, cross-checked against the Wurth FEA table

decisions.what: Vendor thermal numbers are stated on 2oz copper; board is 1oz - deferred to P8 check_thermal on real geometry
decisions.why: theta_JC is package-internal so it barely moves, and the architect's governing model computed board-to-ambient independently; resolving this on measured copper at P8 beats re-litigating it on datasheet conditions now

decisions.what: U1 exposed pad enlarged from the pulled 3.200x2.500mm to the vendor Suggested Pad Layout 3.502x2.613mm (approved hand-edit)
decisions.why: -12.6% EP area on a design whose theta_JC closes with zero margin and whose entire thermal path runs through that pad; the vendor's own suggested layout outranks the easyeda2kicad pull

decisions.what: F1 library assets come from KiCad stock (Device:Fuse + 1206 fuse land), not an EasyEDA pull
decisions.why: C3163312 is the only LCSC listing for this MPN and its EasyEDA record 404s; re-sourcing would trade a datasheet-verified true slow-blow part for an unverified one, so the library gap is filled instead of the part changed

decisions.what: P4 must take C4 polarity from the footprint silk +/- mark, not the symbol
decisions.why: The pulled aluminium-can symbol has generic pin names 1/2 with no polarity semantics, while the footprint carries an explicit +/- pair with pin1=+

decisions.what: NO series gate resistor on Q1 - my spawn instruction was wrong, the schematic agent correctly followed the architecture
decisions.why: blocks.md B1 and sheets.md s5.4 both explicitly forbid a gate RC, and the P1 architect already proved a gate RC cannot limit inrush here (the body diode is forward in the normal direction); R1=100k is the gate path and D2 clamps Vgs

decisions.what: C3 refitted as the Eq.19 COMP HF pole (COMP->GND) at 10pF, NOT the Eq.20 feedforward across R6; sheets.md s3 to be amended
decisions.why: Measured both: as feedforward it pushes |T| at fsw/2 to -8..-2 dB and breaks the vendor's own <-10 dB gain-margin target; as the Eq.19 pole it costs 8 deg of PM (we hold 65-72 deg) and buys -16 dB

decisions.what: Feedback divider 115k/22.1k -> 105k/20.0k
decisions.why: 105k/20.0k hits the required 5.2500 ratio exactly (Vout 5.0000 V) and moves the worst-case low corner from 4.9034 V to 4.9401 V - 3.4 mV of margin becomes 40 mV, at no cost

decisions.what: P9 BOM/CPL must filter DNP by the Variant field manually - no script in the skill reads any DNP mark
decisions.why: J1, J2, R9, C16 are marked Variant=DNP (the only marking a generator can reach, ksa hard-codes (dnp no)); left unfiltered, P9 would ship four parts as populated including both hand-solder screw terminals

decisions.what: DNP snubber upsized: R9 0603->1206, C16 1nF X7R->470pF C0G 1206
decisions.why: Reviewer showed C*V^2*f = 162 mW at 18V (338 mW at the 26V ring) into an 0603 rated 0.1 W - a DNP footprint that destroys itself when populated is a trap; 470pF/1206 gives 76 mW into 0.25 W

decisions.what: Loop calibration claim WITHDRAWN - the x0.83 realisation factor is not evidenced
decisions.why: Reviewer read the vendor's Fig.29 and found C4=33pF IS fitted in the published Bode plot, so the author's 'PM 79-84 vs published 81.6' compared the wrong variant; design still passes at ~46-53 deg worst case vs the 45 deg floor, but the margin is smaller than P4 claimed and only a real loop measurement can close it

decisions.what: Silkscreen connector labelling carried FORWARD to P6/P8 as a tracked requirement
decisions.why: It is delegate Q30's ONLY mitigation for the swapped input/output failure mode (both terminals are identical 5.08mm 2-pin), and it is unreachable from a schematic generator - so it must not die in a P4 note

decisions.what: Hot-plug inrush: 26V voltage declaration KEPT, current bounded by the damped path, residual risk accepted and documented
decisions.why: The 0.05-ohm/180A row assumes an ALL-CERAMIC Cin; this board deliberately carries C4 at 80 mOhm ESR as a damping requirement, so that row is not our configuration. Keeping 26V is conservative for part ratings and costs nothing. Residual: AO4407A body-diode single-pulse capability is unpublished, so the peak cannot be closed from sourced data - and screw terminals are a wire-then-power connector, not a hot-plug one

decisions.what: The clean ERC is WEAK evidence for U1 and must not be cited as pin-level proof
decisions.why: Reviewer noted nearly every U1 pin is declared 'passive' in the pulled library, so ERC cannot catch a mis-wired IC pin here; the real pin-level evidence is the datasheet-extract cross-check and the reviewer's independent netlist read

decisions.what: Load-step prediction restated as 181 mV (not 148 mV) against the 200 mV limit
decisions.why: Reviewer applied the author's own 0.83 realisation factor consistently; also the 0->3A step starts in PFM which the CCM model does not cover, so P8 must treat 9.5% margin as the honest figure

decisions.what: Load step accepted AT the 200 mV limit on the corrected reading (148 mV modelled); R5=75k stands, no rework
decisions.why: Measured R5 sweep shows no value clears fc, PM and dV together - 82k and 91k FAIL phase margin, the binding requirement; and dV is mathematically invariant in COUT (fc scales 1/COUT so fc*COUT is constant), so buying more output capacitance would be pure cost for zero transient gain

decisions.what: The fc 25-50 kHz target was an ORCHESTRATOR proxy, not a requirement - the 24.4 kHz floor is not a miss
decisions.why: The real spec is 100 us recovery; at 24.4 kHz settling is 32.6 us, a 3.1x margin. Recorded so no later phase re-litigates a 2.4% shortfall against a number that was never the specification

decisions.what: Loop compensation is the board's #1 bring-up bench item; R5/C2/C3 are three adjacent 0603 parts, re-tunable without a respin
decisions.why: Every loop number rests on extrapolating a one-point vendor calibration onto a different circuit, and the vendor's published GM matches no reader-built model - only a bench Bode plot can close it

decisions.what: Mounting holes come from the schematic (H1-H4), not board_init - re-run with --mounting-holes 0
decisions.why: Passing 4 duplicated the schematic's own H1-H4 and produced the last 2 parity items; sourcing them from the schematic keeps them real parts with nets and BOM semantics, and P6 places them at the corners

decisions.what: Thermal via array is 12, not the specified 16 - 16 is geometrically impossible
decisions.why: EP is 3.502x2.613mm; four 0.55mm lands at 1.0mm pitch need 3.55mm, and JLC's 0.5mm hole-to-hole floor caps it at 3x4=12 at 0.9-0.95mm pitch. Cost is R_via 2.48 vs 1.90 K/W = +0.5 C of Tj, inside the margin. check_thermal would not have caught this

decisions.what: J1/J2 rotations corrected in placement.edges: J1=270, J2=90 (were 0 and 180)
decisions.why: The declared rotations pointed BOTH screw-terminal wire entries into the board; proven by orthographic side render, because the mouth is the SHORTER plastic face on this part and the WRL bbox alone would have misled

decisions.what: Anneal candidates REJECTED on merit; hand structure kept
decisions.why: Candidates reached HPWL 224.6 vs 234.0 but the 3.1% is almost entirely plane-fed GND, all four carried 5-7 courtyard overlaps after repair, and cand1 pulled R7 3.5mm closer to L1 and lengthened /FB

decisions.what: TOOLCHAIN GOTCHA: placement.fixed silently disables separation constraints
decisions.why: Fixed refs are excluded from the annealer's cluster list, so all 8 separation pairs landed in separation_unknown_refs at zero cost weight; verified all 8 by hand instead (C4-U1 22.2mm, F1-U1 11.1, R6-L1 9.8, J2-L1 16.5) - all pass

decisions.what: P7 must pour the four GND planes AND pour /SW as a zone BEFORE any autoroute
decisions.why: The 0.83 route probe is an artifact: GND is 25 of 71 connections and plane-fed, so unpoured Freerouting tried it as 2.055mm tracks; and aiee_pwr_width_SW (2.31mm) applies to every /SW track including the 0603 bootstrap cap's - a zone is not a track, so the rule does not bind it

decisions.what: P5 omitted the mandatory keepout translation; corrected at P6
decisions.why: placement.keepouts rects were still board-local, so three landed off-board entirely and the fourth produced a phantom violation; translated in constraints.json and annotated

decisions.what: 25 structural footprints left LOCKED - P8 fixers must unlock before nudging
decisions.why: Placement cost 8 edit iterations and the hot-loop geometry is the design; locking prevents a later fixer from silently undoing it, but the lock must be visible to whoever needs to move something

decisions.what: thermal.min_vias lowered 16 -> 12 in constraints.json with the geometry recorded
decisions.why: 16 cannot physically fit (EP 3.502x2.613mm vs 3.55mm needed at 1.0mm pitch, JLC 0.5mm hole-to-hole floor); 16 was our own derivation not a vendor spec, and leaving it would fail check_thermal at P8 on an unachievable target. Copper-area criteria unchanged, Tj cost +0.5 C

decisions.what: C:/Program Files/Git/SW poured as a ZONE, not routed as tracks
decisions.why: aiee_pwr_width_SW demands 2.31mm on every /SW track including the 0603 bootstrap cap's, which is impossible at that pad; a zone is not a track so the rule does not bind it - the alternative would have been weakening a current-carrying rule

decisions.what: Forced --power-layers In1.Cu,In2.Cu,B.Cu instead of the auto heuristic
decisions.why: auto considers inner layers only, so B.Cu would have been fair game for power routing and would have cut the second radiating face on a board that closes on 7 C of thermal margin

decisions.what: Freerouting necking fixed by pour fan-in; no rule weakened
decisions.why: FR routed at exactly the pad widths (0.8058mm = 0402 pad) despite --pad-window clearing all 61 power pads; remediation ladder step 4 applied, leaving .kicad_dru, .kicad_pro netclasses and constraints.json byte-unchanged

decisions.what: ORCHESTRATOR ERROR corrected by the router: B.Cu >=650 mm2 within 14.3mm of U1 is impossible
decisions.why: That disc clipped to the 50x40 outline is only 608.3 mm2; the constraint's _note says 650 is check_thermal's A_sat SUMMED over layers, which measures 2169.7 mm2. I restated the constraint wrongly in the spawn prompt

decisions.what: route_critical and route_cleanup both skipped, deliberately
decisions.why: route_critical skips plane/pour-carried power nets by design and every power net ended up plane- or pour-carried; route_cleanup's loop-breaker has regressed on pour boards twice and DRC was already 0/0

decisions.what: ACCEPT deletion of 3 of 9 U1 ring vias; U1 keeps 12 EP + 6 ring = 18
decisions.why: Each sat in a 1.06-1.58mm GND finger, so it was current-limited by the finger not the via and carried no real share; the nearest legal >=2.055mm spot was 5-6.5mm away ACROSS the /SW pour, which would route return current under the switch node - exactly what the brief forbids. Deleting beats relocating, and 18 still exceeds the min_vias 12 requirement

decisions.what: SCRIPT DEFECT: check_current.pour_neck erodes each zone fill in isolation
decisions.why: A pour split across zone objects (KiCad knocks a lower-priority same-net zone out of a higher-priority one) reports a phantom 0.00mm neck with pos in a different structure from the real defect; it should union same-net fills per layer or emit a distinct fill_fragmented kind. Cost most of this fix's analysis time

decisions.what: SCRIPT GAP: stitch_vias accepts a candidate whose surrounding same-net pour is narrower than the net's IPC-2152 width
decisions.why: The (60.72,60.225) stitch landed in a 1.06mm GND channel and became a P8 error; existing rejects (foreign_copper, near_same_net_via) do not cover pour width

decisions.what: SELF-CORRECTION: reverted pdn=false on +5V and GND; used waivers instead
decisions.why: pdn=false silenced check_pdn's category error but ALSO excluded both nets from check_irdrop - the two highest-current nets on the board. A waiver states 'this check does not apply' without disabling unrelated analysis. Restored coverage now reads +5V 9.0mV / GND 1.1mV drop

decisions.what: SPICE sim gate NOT run - deliberate scope call, recorded as a deviation
decisions.why: P2 nominated only SIM-1 (FB divider setpoint) and SIM-2 (EN/UVLO thresholds), both static DC-tolerance fragments already verified TWICE analytically with exact numbers by the P4 author and independently by the fresh-context reviewer (who showed 1% parts miss by 32-36mV); house policy forbids simming the buck switching for lack of vendor models, so SPICE would restate arithmetic rather than test anything new

decisions.what: CRITICAL FIX: D2 cathode marker was on the anode end; moved (41.720,59.125) -> (45.900,59.000)
decisions.why: Assembled per the wrong silk, the 15V Zener reverses into a forward diode holding Vgs at -0.7V, Q1 never enhances, 2.6A runs in its body diode at ~2.1W in an SO-8 - Q1 and the reverse-polarity protection both destroyed. Netlist was always correct; only the marker was wrong. Now 0.640mm from pad 1 (cathode) vs 3.036mm from pad 2, agreeing with the footprint band and pin-1 dot

decisions.what: ACCEPT 3 residual misattributed refdes labels (C9->C7, R7->C12, C2->C3); 8 fixed
decisions.why: At 1.0mm refdes size the inked label is 2.6-3.2mm wide against a 2.5-3.0mm passive pitch, so no attribution-clean position exists at any legal clearance; 0.8mm text would clear two but move_text has no size field. Mitigation: all FUNCTIONAL legends are correct (VIN/VOUT/polarity/TP names), SMT is machine-placed from the CPL not from silk, and only J1/J2 are hand-soldered - their legends are correct

decisions.what: KEEP the fixer's remove_text addition to place_edit.py/place_swig.py (out-of-protocol skill change)
decisions.why: add_text matches on (layer,string,position) so it can create or update in place but never RELOCATE; without remove_text the only options were raw-editing the board (forbidden) or shipping the board-killing D2 marker. Additive, regression-tested, 66/66 place tests pass

decisions.what: THERMAL RESTATED: Tj ~98.7 C, margin 6.3 C (not 7.1), band 87.5-108.4 C at +/-30%
decisions.why: The reviewer showed check_thermal's 0.83 C headroom is NOT a layout property - a_eff measures 2137mm2 and clamps to A_SAT 645, so theta is constant for any 4L board above 645mm2 and the vias/planes move it 0.00 C. The believable number is the P1/P2 ladder, corrected: it still assumed 16 vias at 2.16 K/W, and 12 vias gives ~2.88 K/W = +0.76 C

decisions.what: ORCHESTRATOR DIAGNOSIS WRONG: the TP silk dfm error was NOT a mask-aperture overlap
decisions.why: I estimated a ~0.92mm aperture; measured it is 1.7664mm2 = exactly pi*0.75^2, zero mask expansion. Real cause is lib/gerblib.py read_gerber chording drawn arcs, so KiCad's two 180-degree arcs collapse onto the diameter - a phantom 1.5x0.12mm bar = 0.1798mm2 exactly. My suggested fallback (enlarge the ring) could never have worked, since the chord crosses the centre at any radius

decisions.what: SCRIPT DEFECT (high value, NOT fixed this run): lib/gerblib.py chords drawn arcs
decisions.why: The S12 approximate_arcs fix was applied to _flash_polys only, not to Line/Arc in read_gerber, so EVERY footprint drawing a silk ring around a pad - every stock TestPoint, many polarity rings - will fail the dfm gate forever. Recorded for a future T-step rather than fixed here, because deletion already cleared this board and skill work belongs in its own session

decisions.what: 12.7um clearance was a priority-0 pour crumb in a 0.02mm inter-zone lane
decisions.why: KiCad deburrs a pour at min_thickness BEFORE subtracting higher-priority zone outlines, so a sub-min_thickness lane between two zone outlines gets refilled and never deburred; the P8 Z2 edge at y=51.12 'clearing' zone 2 at 51.1 is what manufactured it. Fixed with a priority-6 bridge zone; a second unflagged 0.02x1.93mm hair went with it

decisions.what: DISCLOSE, do not fix: 2 residual etch slivers and a 0.5um island-gap margin
decisions.why: Slivers 0.05x1.71mm and 0.078x0.497mm are fused to neighbouring copper so no gate fires, but a fab may query them; the min F.Cu island gap is 0.1021mm against JLC's 0.1016 floor, so ANY further pour edit risks tripping dfm_clearance - the risk of touching exceeds the risk of leaving
